title: MemoryVLN: From Ego-Aware Memory Representation to Cross-Context Memory Reuse in Vision-Language Navigation

body: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied vision-language navigation (VLN), yet their performance degrades on long-horizon trajectories due to context-length limits, redundant historical observations, and unstable spatial alignment across time. These issues make it difficult to both compress long navigation histories and reliably reuse past spatial experience. To address these limitations, we propose MemoryVLN, a unified memory-driven navigation system built around memory construction and management. During memory construction, Long Sequence Compression employs forgetting-curve-inspired temporal sampling to preserve dense recent evidence and sparse yet representative distant observations under a limited token budget. Ego-Aware Memory Representation further integrates 2D semantic tokens, 3D geometric tokens, and 6D agent poses, allowing each memory to encode both what was observed and where it was observed. During memory management, Hierarchical Memory Bank maintains in-episode and context-level memories through cross-context warm-start and confidence-controlled write-back. Memory Enhancement then retrieves the Top-K relevant memories according to the current navigation state and fuses them with the current visual tokens. Together, these mechanisms transform raw navigation history into compact, spatially grounded, selectively retrievable, and reusable navigation experience. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art baselines by a substantial margin (i.e., 2% and 6.5% in successful rate).
summaryZh: 本文提出了MemoryVLN系统，旨在解决大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在长程具身导航任务中面临的上下文长度限制、历史信息冗余及空间对齐不稳定等挑战。该系统通过引入遗忘曲线启发的长序列压缩技术，结合包含2D语义、3D几何及6D位姿信息的“自我感知记忆表示”，实现了对导航历史的紧凑编码。此外，分层记忆库与记忆增强机制支持跨上下文的记忆重用与检索。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准测试中，该方法在成功率上显著优于现有最优基线，为具身智能体在复杂环境下的长期记忆管理提供了有效方案。

glossary.explanationZh: 视觉语言导航，指智能体根据自然语言指令在视觉环境中进行路径规划的任务。
长程轨迹，指智能体在执行任务时需要经过较长时间或较长距离的移动过程。
自我感知记忆表示，一种将智能体自身位姿与环境语义、几何信息结合的记忆编码方式。
分层记忆库，用于维护不同时间尺度（如单次任务内与跨任务）记忆的存储结构。
Token预算，指模型在处理序列时受限于上下文窗口大小所能使用的最大Token数量。
